description: ZERO-LOGGING DRAFT: proposes the log_session payload for a guided gym session so the user only confirms it. Give `workoutKey`, or `date` for the latest guided session of that day (exactly one). It reads the laps (compare_workout_to_plan's mapping; `plan` as there) and the FIT's HR quality, and builds per exercise sets x reps @ load from the guide's text. IMPORTANT: the watch records only the guide's PLANNED text, never reps and weights done, so every rep count and weight in the draft is an ASSUMPTION (assumed: true) the user must confirm or correct before anything is logged. Per-set guides: the set count is the number of set laps; per-exercise and workout guides: the plan's. It lists every deviation and what to ask (`confirm`). A distance or time after the x ('3x40m') is not taken as reps; a missing weight is left out, never guessed. It NEVER writes anything: after the user confirms or corrects the draft, call log_session with it and source: 'draft'. Downloads the ~550 KB FIT.

date.description: Instead of workoutKey: the local date; the latest guided session of that day is drafted.

plan.description: Optional: the exercises array given to push_strength_guide, as for compare_workout_to_plan.

name: draft_session_log
title: Draft a session log from the watch data (read-only; the user confirms, then log_session)
